get.description:
The `parent` and `source` objects are present when the repository is a fork. `parent` is the repository this repository was forked from, `source` is the ultimate source for the network.

When present and non-empty, `temp_clone_token` is a temporary credential for read-only Git access to this repository. It expires five minutes after generation and cannot be used to push changes. Treat this value as sensitive and avoid recording it in logs.

> [!NOTE]
> - In order to see the `security_and_analysis` block for a repository you must have admin permissions for the repository or be an owner or security manager for the organization that owns the repository. For more information, see "[Managing security managers in your organization](https://docs.github.com/organizations/managing-peoples-access-to-your-organization-with-roles/managing-security-managers-in-your-organization)."
> - To view merge-related settings, you must have the `contents:read` and `contents:write` permissions.

get.summary: List repositories for the authenticated user
get.description:
Lists repositories that the authenticated user has explicit permission (`:read`, `:write`, or `:admin`) to access.

The authenticated user has explicit permission to access repositories they own, repositories where they are a collaborator, and repositories that they can access through an organization membership.

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: Limit results to repositories with the specified visibility.

parameters.name: affiliation
parameters.description:
Comma-separated list of values. Can include:  
 * `owner`: Repositories that are owned by the authenticated user.  
 * `collaborator`: Repositories that the user has been added to as a collaborator.  
 * `organization_member`: Repositories that the user has access to through being a member of an organization. This includes every repository on every team that the user is on.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Limit results to repositories of the specified type. Will cause a `422` error if used in the same request as **visibility** or **affiliation**.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The property to sort the results by.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: The order to sort by. Default: `asc` when using `full_name`, otherwise `desc`.

get.summary: List runner applications for a repository
get.description:
Lists binaries for the runner application that you can download and run.

Authenticated users must have admin access to the repository to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
